name: GPS Jamming
Description: Radio frequency interference that overpowers weak GPS signals from satellites, preventing the drone's GPS receiver from locking onto coordinates.
Symptoms: Sudden drop in the number of tracked satellites to zero or near-zero
Loss of GPS lock status indicator in the ground control telemetry
Inability to hold position or hover stably in GPS-dependent flight modes
Impact: Loss of autonomous navigation, causing the drone to drift with the wind, lose return-to-home capabilities, or force an immediate emergency landing in unverified terrain.
Recommended Action: Trigger a fallback flight mode that relies strictly on non-GPS navigation (e.g., optical flow, visual odometry, or altitude hold). Command the drone to hover and wait for signal recovery, or execute a controlled descent if signal loss persists.
